Pattern: global loading indicator.description: A top-level progress bar driven by the pending navigation. Render it in the root layout.

Pattern: submit button pending state.description: Disable the button and swap its label while the action runs, so double submits are impossible.

Pattern: per-item pending with fetchers.description:
Collect the ids of every in-flight fetcher so each row can show its own spinner.
The list-view counterpart to a single form's pending state.

Pattern: delayed spinner.description:
Only show a spinner once the navigation is genuinely slow.
Fast transitions finish before the timer fires, avoiding a flash that reads as jank.
